I see you have a significant history; can you tell me specifically what conditions you were diagnosed with and when your symptoms of gait and limb ataxia began?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with focus on posterior fossa.
REQUEST TEST: Serum Vitamin E and Copper levels.

text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML. Serum Vitamin E and Copper levels: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement and your history of significant medical conditions, have you ever been treated with immunosuppressive therapies or have a condition like HIV that affects your immune system?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Have you experienced any visual changes such as vision loss or blurry spots, and did you have any prior episodes of neurological decline or infections?

REQUEST TEST: CD4 Count if HIV status unknown; Visual_Evoked_Potential.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CD4 Count: NORMAL READINGS; Visual_Evoked_Potential: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the results; since your CD4 count and visual evoked potentials are normal, we must consider other causes for the demyelinating lesions seen on your MRI. Have you noticed any worsening of your coordination specifically when walking in the dark or at night?

REQUEST TEST: Serum Paraneoplastic Antibodies (e.g., Anti-Yo, Anti-Hu); REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Spine.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Serum Paraneoplastic Antibodies: NORMAL READINGS; MRI Spine: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal paraneoplastic antibodies and a clear spine MRI, can you tell me if you have any history of autoimmune disorders like multiple sclerosis, or if you've ever experienced episodes of fever, headache, or stiff neck?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy for Crohn's disease.
